label: Best months
value: April to October (the main tourist season for Swat)
quote: the main tourist season for Swat begins in spring and lasts till autumn (April to October)

label: Winter
value: December to February; the guide says it is for snow lovers and skiing in Malam Jabba
quote: Winter (December to February): For snow lovers and skiing in Malam Jabba.
source: Bloom Pakistan, Islamabad to Swat travel guide 2025

label: Altitude
value: About 1,435 m (4,708 ft) at the town, per Wikipedia

label: Night driving
value: Avoid night travel due to fog and narrow turns
quote: Avoid night travel due to fog and narrow turns.
source: Bloom Pakistan, Islamabad to Swat travel guide 2025

label: Base for the lakes trail
value: A base camp for the trail to the Daral and Saidgai lakes
quote: It also serves as a base camp for the trail that leads to the Daral and Saidgai lakes.
